law_zh: 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》
law_en: Measures for Labelling AI-Generated and Synthetic Content (China)
issuer_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室、工业和信息化部、公安部、国家广播电视总局
issuer_en: Cyberspace Administration of China, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security and the National Radio and Television Administration
standard_zh: 配套强制性国家标准 GB 45438-2025《网络安全技术 人工智能生成合成内容标识方法》，2025-02-28 发布、2025-09-01 同日实施；标识分显式（文字/声音/图形，用户可感知）与隐式（写进文件数据，用户不易感知）两种。
standard_en: The mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025 (Cybersecurity technology — Labelling method for AI-generated and synthetic content) was published 2025-02-28 and took effect the same day, 2025-09-01. Labels come in two forms: explicit (text, sound or graphics a user can perceive) and implicit (written into the file data, not readily perceptible).

duties.zh: 你自己发的时候要主动标：用户通过网络信息内容传播服务发布生成合成内容的，**应当主动声明，并使用服务提供者提供的标识功能进行标识**。也就是说，发微博、小红书、抖音、B 站时，平台那个「声明为 AI 生成」的开关是给你用的，不是可选装饰。
duties.en: Declare it yourself when you post: a user publishing AI-generated or synthetic content through a content-dissemination service **must proactively declare it and use the labelling function the platform provides**. The "mark as AI-generated" toggle on a Chinese platform is an obligation, not a nicety.

duties.zh: 不能把标识抹掉：任何组织和个人**不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿**本办法规定的生成合成内容标识，**也不得为他人实施上述行为提供工具或者服务**，不得通过不正当标识手段损害他人合法权益。注意后半句——提供「去 AI 标识」工具本身就在禁止之列。
duties.en: Do not strip the label: no organisation or individual may **maliciously delete, alter, forge or conceal** the labels this measure requires, **nor provide others with tools or services for doing so**, nor harm others' rights through improper labelling. Note the second clause — shipping a label-removal tool is itself prohibited.

duties.zh: 「导出来没有水印」本身不违法：办法允许用户要求提供**不含显式标识**的内容，服务提供者在用户协议中明确用户的标识义务与使用责任后即可提供，并依法留存接收者信息与相关日志不少于六个月。所以免费档导出无水印不等于违规——但**标注责任落到了你头上**，第十条照样要履行。
duties.en: A watermark-free export is not itself unlawful: users may request content **without an explicit label**, and the provider may supply it once the user agreement sets out the user's labelling duties and responsibility for use, retaining recipient information and logs for at least six months. So a clean free-tier export is not a violation — but **the labelling duty has moved onto you**, and Article 10 still applies.

notes.zh: **「去水印」是两件事，别混为一谈。**去掉「AI 生成」标识，是第十一条明确禁止的行为；去掉图库、品牌或厂商的商业水印，是版权与合同问题，不在本办法射程内。同一个动作名，两套完全不同的后果。
notes.en: **"Removing the watermark" is two different acts.** Stripping an *AI-generated* label is what Article 11 forbids. Removing a stock-library, brand or vendor watermark is a copyright and contract question and falls outside this measure entirely. Same phrase, two unrelated consequences.

notes.zh: 本站只转述条文原意与出处，不构成法律意见。这条规则与厂商条款相互独立：厂商说可商用，不免除你在中国大陆平台发布时的标识义务；厂商要求标注出处，也不能替代平台的 AI 声明开关。
notes.en: This site restates the text and cites its source; it is not legal advice. This rule is independent of vendor terms: a vendor granting commercial rights does not lift your labelling duty on a Chinese platform, and a vendor's attribution requirement is not a substitute for the platform's AI-declaration toggle.

source_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室等四部门《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》（cac.gov.cn/2025-03/14/c_1743654684782215.htm，2025-03-14 公布、2025-09-01 施行）与新华网 2025-09-01 报道；GB 45438-2025 见国家标准全文公开系统 openstd.samr.gov.cn。本站在当前网络环境下无法直接抓取上述页面正文，条文表述经搜索索引引文与人民网转发稿交叉核对。
source_en: Measures for Labelling AI-Generated and Synthetic Content, issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and three other ministries (cac.gov.cn/2025-03/14/c_1743654684782215.htm, published 2025-03-14, in force 2025-09-01), with Xinhua's 2025-09-01 report; GB 45438-2025 is on the SAMR national-standard portal at openstd.samr.gov.cn. This environment cannot fetch the body of those pages directly, so the wording of the articles was cross-checked against search-index citations and the People's Daily Online reprint.
